lines.t: Firstborn sons, stand up, lift your eyes to the throne of fire and light
Laid-down crowns at His feet, this is how a man of Heaven learns to fight
Strong in the Spirit, weak in self, every breath a war against his pride
We don’t bow to the flesh, we bow to the Lamb who was pierced in our side
I crucify my will, lay it down in the dust at His command
I gain my life in the wound of the Lamb, weapon in His hand
Make me a king who is ruled by the King, I don’t rule my own
Make me a son who obeys to the death till You call me home
This is what a man is, knees down, hands up, sword drawn to the sky
Heart locked in covenant, eyes on the flame in the Master’s eyes
Call me to the judgment seat, I’ll stand in the fire, I won’t run
True power is obedience, true glory is the fear of the Son
I don’t need that spotlight, I just need Your voice
I don’t need her body if she ain’t in Your choice
Keep me in the river, wash me in Your blood
I only want a woman who’s hidden in Your love
Yeah, I walk through the city with a war in my chest and a crown in my gaze
I’m sent to the corners of the night where the wolves still howl for praise
Mind in the Spirit, body on lock, I don’t chase no painted snare
If her lips drip honey but her soul breathes death, I ain’t going thereI seen kings fall flat for a curve in the hip and a look in the eye
Saw thrones get burned for a moment of flesh and a whispered lie
I’m a son, I’m a priest, I’m a lion on a leash in the hand of the King
Every urge gets tried in the fire, if it ain’t Holy, it don’t get to breathe
I put my thoughts on the altar till they scream and die
I chain my eyes to the narrow, let the lust walk by
I’d rather burn with desire in the night than bow to it once in the light
I’d rather walk alone with the King than lay in a bed that He don’t delight
This is what a man is, head bowed low, but his back won’t bend
Heart like flint for the truth, open scars where the pride got pinned
You can keep your kingdom built on sand and adrenaline rush
I want rulership in the age to come, I want a scepter I can trust
Teach me to reign by surrender
Teach me to rule by the Cross
If I lose myself to Your fire
I’ll never count it loss
Head of the woman, but servant of the King, that’s order, not pride
If she walks in the Light, I’ll cover her life, I’ll bleed, I’ll die
But if her beauty is a veil for rebellion and war in her soul
I’d rather walk single in the desert with God than married in a palace of moldI’m not bowing to a smile that mocks the Name I bear
I’m not trading firstborn rights for a night in her hair
I was built for thrones and nations, not for moments in the dark
So I’ll guard this seed inside me like a live, burning spark
Call me higher, break my pride
If I fall, bring me to the Cross, let my ego die
Make me faithful, make me strong
You are where my kingship lies, You are where I belong
This is what a man is, laid out flat at the feet of the Lord
Heart like thunder, voice like steel when he speaks Your Word
Crowned in glory when the age rolls in, scepter in hand
I’ll rule with You in power and love, a son, a king, a man
If I lose the crowd, don’t let me lose Your flame
If I lose my strength, don’t let me lose Your name
I came from dust, but You’re my only breath
I’ll be Yours in life, I’ll be Yours in death
